newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo seeks reason for Thomson decision.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo seeks reason for Thomson decision.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Electronics Chairman Bae Soon-hoon wants to know the "real reason" behind the French government's decision to suspend the sale of electronics group Thomson SA, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
"We are trying to find out the real reason behind the French government's announcement of temporarily suspending the privatisation process," spokesman Park Sung-il quoted the chairman as saying.
"We'll closely examine and confront any development to the situation," the Daewoo chairman added.

"We don't know yet what the French government's position is from the information we've received so far, but it's difficult to conclude that the privatisation plan has been put off completely," Bae said.
He said considering the French government's international credibility, Daewoo Electronics' plan to take over Thomson Multimedia was unlikely to face too big a change.

The French government said on Wednesday the suspension of the proposed Thomson sell-off to Lagardere Groupe was due to objections to the planned sale of the company's consumer electronics unit to Daewoo.

Several thousand workers of Thomson Multimedia marched in Paris and other cities on November 20 to protest against the sale fearing for their jobs and working conditions. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
